text_block_list.text:
Tracente Academy buzzed with excitement during the public mock races.
Among the competitors, one particular Umamusume caught everyone's eye.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: *pant*... *gasp*...!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Haru Urara is trailing far behind the pack!
With sheer determination written across her face, she's running her heart out!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: I won't... give uuuuup!!

text_block_list.name: Farmer
text_block_list.text: Now's your chance, go for it! Urara-chaaan!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Haru Urara makes her surge from the rear!
She's not quite reaching them! But Haru Urara refuses to back down!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Nnngh... Final spurt...!
GOOOOOOO!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: And across the finish liiine!!!

The reason Haru Urara drew so much attention
wasn't because of blistering speed or elegant form—

text_block_list.name: Neighborhood Lady
text_block_list.text:
Nice fight, Urara-chan!
You really gave it your all in that final stretch!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe! Thanks for cheering me on!
I lost today, but I'm definitely taking 1st place next time!

No matter how many times she lost, she ran with everything she had without ever breaking.
It was that unyielding spirit that captured the hearts of everyone watching.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Trainer!
Hey, how was my time?
choice_data_list: Looks like you didn't beat your personal best...
Looks like you didn't beat your personal best...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Aw, man! And here I thought I had it in the bag today~
Guess I'll just have to train extra hard again tomorrow!
choice_data_list: No need to rush. Let's take it one step at a time.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Okey-dokey!

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text: —Excuse me, do you have a moment?

Out of nowhere, an unfamiliar woman holding a camera approaches us.
She holds out a business card.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Um... "Monthly Umamusume Journal"?
Are you a magazine reporter?

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Ever since I saw you at the debut race the other day,
I've been rooting for you, Haru Urara!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Really?! Ehehe♪ Thank you so much!
...Wait, is that a camera in your hands?

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text: Yes! I took a few photos of you while you were running!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
No way! Lemme see, lemme see!
I wonder what kind of face I make when I run~? I wanna see!

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, of course.
I'll pick out the best shots and send them over to you later!
A few days later, Haru Urara and I checked the photos sent by the reporter.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Waaah! I look so cute! Yay!
Ah! My nostrils are super flared out! How embarrassing!
choice_data_list: There's a message of support in here too.
There's a message of support in here too.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
...She's saying such nice things about me!
Ehehe... Oh! Trainer, she's praising you too!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
"Ever since she teamed up with her Trainer,
her expression has been getting brighter day by day!"

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
"She must have found herself a wonderful Trainer."
...It says! That's awesome, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Yeah, yeah! It makes me super happy too!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
If I run with lots of energy, not only do I get praised,
Trainer gets praised too...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
...Ehehe♪
All right, I'm gonna give it even, even more!
